title: The volcano blast that circled Earth 4 times 🌋
subject: volcano
description:
Did you feel or hear the Tonga eruption where you live? 👇

On January 15, 2022, the underwater volcano Hunga Tonga–Hunga Haʻapai sent a pressure wave around Earth 4 times, a plume 57 km high and the most intense lightning ever recorded. It was heard in Alaska, about 9,400 km away.

Sources: NASA Science, "Aura Measurements of an Underwater Volcano Eruption"; USGS, "Tonga's Hunga eruption produced most intense lightning ever recorded" (2023); EarthSky, "Tonga volcano felt around the world" (2022); Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory via Newswise (Science, 2023)

scenes.text: A volcano's shockwave went around Earth 4 times.
On January 15, 2022, Hunga Tonga–Hunga Haʻapai exploded under the South Pacific.
Its plume climbed 57 kilometers, into the mesosphere. No volcano had ever been measured that high.
Inside it, lightning peaked at 2,615 flashes a minute, the most intense ever recorded.
In Alaska, about 9,400 kilometers away, people heard the boom.
It also blasted 146 million tonnes of water into the stratosphere, about 10 percent of what was already there.
